exposure: COVID-19 positive PCR test result during pregnancy
outcome: Expression of cell surface markers (CD44, CD105, CD73, CD90, CD29, CD34, CD45, CD19, CD14)
Differentiation potential of placenta-derived mesenchymal stem cells into osteocytes
Differentiation potential of placenta-derived mesenchymal stem cells into adipocytes
cohort: Placenta tissues were obtained from 30 COVID-19 positive women and 30 normal healthy women, all aged 20-40 years, who underwent cesarean section.
finding: Human placenta tissue contains mesenchymal stem cells with the potential to differentiate into adipocytes and osteocytes, and this potential was not influenced by the COVID-19 virus in the mothers.
